title: Simple and effective
body: I was looking for a simple and effective app for checking off days to track health habit without having a bunch of useless options. Exactly what I needed! And you can also by an ad-free version for a few bucks without subscription! Thank you to the developer for opting for simplicity! Greatly appreciated.
author: MlieB51

title: Absolut Scam
body:
After a week it kick itself behind a paywall.

Installed it to track sport progression. Lost everything. Don’t install it, there is plenty of better similar software for free.
author: B0UTEILLE

title: Inutilisable
body: Une semaine d’essai, après ça, l’application demande à prendre un compte premium et est complètement inutilisable. Il n’y a pas d’achat intégré, c’est un achat tout court, sinon au bout d’une semaine c’est totalement fini. A éviter, trouver une autre application parce que celle si ne vous permettra absolument rien sans compte payant.
author: Jrmle

title: Not so bad, but could be improved
body:
Ultra simple. Relatively efficient, but only portrait format is available, which is less comfortable on IPAD.
Notifications are missing.
author: NUCOURT
